name: Fabric Welcome Banner
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from 100% polyester fabric for a lightweight, soft, and durable finish.
    - Features a smooth fabric surface that helps showcase printed text and artwork clearly.
    - Designed with strong metal grommets for secure and easy hanging.
    - Finished with decorative ribbons that add an elegant and beautiful touch.
    - Each product includes 2 satin ribbons in the same color
    - Reinforced stitching helps improve durability for indoor and event display use.
    - Lightweight material allows the banner to hang neatly without feeling too heavy.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 4 sizes:
             +) 12 x 40 in ~ 30.48 x 101.6 cm
             +) 15 x 50 in ~ 38.1 x 127 cm
             +) 20 x 63 in ~ 50.8 x 160.02 cm
             +) 24 x 75 in ~ 60.96 x 190.5 cm
    - Ribbon size: 1.02 x 98.42 in ~ 2.6 x 250cm
    📌 Note: Please allow up to ±2 cm difference due to manual measurement.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - One-sided printing with vibrant colors and sharp image details.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative welcome banner for weddings and special events.
    - Ideal for hanging at wedding entrances, ceremony areas, reception venues, photo backdrops, hallways, and event aisles.
    - Strong metal grommets help the banner hang securely and easily.
    - Decorative ribbons add a soft, elegant finishing touch to the overall display.
    - Suitable for both indoor use and covered outdoor event setups.
    - Perfect for displaying personalized names, dates, welcome wording, and meaningful event messages.
    - Lightweight fabric makes it easy to carry, hang, remove, fold, and store after use.
    - Can be reused as an event keepsake or memory piece after the celebration.
    - Helps create a clean, elegant, and personalized atmosphere for the venue.
    - A beautiful décor piece for weddings, engagements, anniversaries, bridal showers, baby showers, birthdays, graduations, retirement parties, vow renewals, baptisms, housewarming parties, holiday celebrations, and other special events.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for weddings, engagement parties, and bridal showers.
    - A beautiful personalized décor piece for ceremony entrances and reception spaces.
    - Great for couples who want elegant and customized wedding decorations.
    - A meaningful keepsake gift for newlyweds after the event.
    - Suitable for romantic celebrations, vow renewals, and anniversary events.
    - Ideal for anyone looking for a simple, elegant, and personalized event banner.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Fabric Welcome Banner

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1.5-2cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
